description: Real JOINs on strait-1 with the shipped config: units with a node target forward-deploy at west-airbase (paying their loadout) and move along their routes for 10 game minutes; trucks and units with no target spawn at the sanctuary; rejects for a unit in sortie, an unknown node, a node no road reaches and an unplayable role (NX-122). Aircraft without a target stay landed; the strike jet flies toward east-airbase and is shot down by the enemy SAM site there, after a first hit, before it arrives (NX-124).
